boundary: Exact finite Ornstein-Uhlenbeck/Hodge identity. The two sectors are uncoupled in this model, so no physical heat current or experimental nonequilibrium engine is claimed.
connection_to_exergy: The same 81/79 projector split that controls Pass4251 reversible Gaussian exergy is exactly the split of fluctuation-response temperatures in this linear stochastic model.

ou_model.noise_covariance: 2 k_B (gamma_H T_H P_H + gamma_G T_G P_G) delta(t-t')
ou_model.response: R(t)=exp(-gamma_H t) P_H + exp(-gamma_G t) P_G for t>=0
ou_model.sector_FDT: C_H(t)=k_B T_H R_H(|t|), C_G(t)=k_B T_G R_G(|t|)
ou_model.stationary_correlation: C(t)=k_B[T_H exp(-gamma_H |t|) P_H + T_G exp(-gamma_G |t|) P_G]
